comments.body:
Treasure cove item beginning June 26th through July 10th. You may choose one of the following items from it:

Stuffed Dolphin
Sun Wukong's Clothes
Sun Wukong's Headband
Sun Wukong's Boots
Ruyi Bang
Lily of the Valley Staff
Wing Bow

Cheers.
